title: fix(react): stop reading the retired `navigation.view` and substituting it for the navigation-MODE token
body:
Fixes #9874

`useNavigationOverlay` read `navigation.view` — removed in `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 under ADR-0049 — and spent it in the argument that carries the navigation MODE token. This stops both.

## The premise, re-measured at source

Every reading below is mine, taken in a worktree off `origin/main` `f5e2fcb4a`.

| probe | dispatch said | I measured | ref · UTC |
|---|---|---|---|
| objectui `origin/main` tip | `02bc27b08` | **`f5e2fcb4a`** — the dispatch's base was stale by the time I fetched | 2026-09-18T18:15:32Z |
| the read | `:275 const view = navigation?.view;` | confirmed, same line | `f5e2fcb4a` · 18:16:06Z |
| the two consumers | `:323` / `:356` `onNavigate(recordId as string OR number, view ?? 'view')` | confirmed, same lines | `f5e2fcb4a` · 18:16:06Z |
| lit control, same command | 4 `onNavigate(` sites; `:314` / `:337` pass the literal `new_window` | confirmed, 4 sites, same lines | `f5e2fcb4a` · 18:16:06Z |
| resolved spec version | `17.4.0` | confirmed — `pnpm-lock.yaml` carries exactly one `@objectstack/spec` version string, `17.4.0`; control in the same command, sibling package `@objectstack/types@17.4.0` | `f5e2fcb4a` · 18:17:55Z |
| declared ranges | "`^17.0.0`, some `^17.2.0` / `^17.3.0`" | **incomplete** — also `^17.1.0` (`packages/react`, `packages/plugin-detail`) and `^17.4.0` (`packages/types`) | `f5e2fcb4a` · 18:17:55Z |

The retirement text was read at source in the sibling repo rather than taken from the card's quotation, on `objectstack` `origin/main` `07c6f822e` (18:16:17Z), `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:1814-1822`. It matches the card verbatim, and its prescription — the half the card did not quote — is load-bearing for this PR:

> Delete the key; to choose what opens for a record, assign a `record` page to the object and let `isDefault` pick the one that opens — page assignment is the machinery that resolves a detail layout, and a list view's navigation block only decides HOW the detail is surfaced (`mode`, `size`).

⇒ the replacement route is page assignment, which lives nowhere near this hook. **No fallback belongs here**, and the fix is subtractive. `retiredKey` is `z.never(...).optional()` (`objectstack:packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key.ts:106`), so on the bump the key types `never` and `view ?? 'view'` would still compile — silently dead rather than loudly broken. That is the reason to remove the read now rather than let the bump find it.

## The census the card left open — and what it turned up

**Question 1, "does any other surface read `navigation?.view`".** Corpus: `git ls-files` at `f5e2fcb4a`, 8090 tracked files, working tree clean.

```
git grep -nE 'navigation(\?)?(\.|\[.)view|nav(\?)?\.view' -- .
```

Four lines, and only one is a read of the live key: the hook itself. The other three are two prose comments and one `packages/types` parity assertion that belongs to objectui#9667. The same command carried a lit control on `navigation?.mode`, which fires across 40-plus lines. **So: no other surface reads it.**

A second probe asked whether anything reads the member off the hook's RESULT — that is the published `NavigationOverlayState.view`:

```
git grep -nE '\b(navOverlay|nav|state)\.view\b' -- 'packages/**' 'apps/**'
```

Zero lines, against a lit control in the same command on the sibling members of the same object (`isOverlay`, `handleClick`, `selectedRecord`, `width`), which fires 20-plus times. I also opened all 12 real call sites of the hook: none destructures `view`. **So the published member has zero readers in this repository.** Hosts outside this repository were NOT measured — that is an unmeasured site, not a negative.

**⭐ Probe A had a blind spot, and stating it is what found the real work.** It matches MEMBER READS, so an object literal authoring the key is invisible to it. A third probe over authoring sites turned up a surface neither the card nor the dispatch names:

`packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/gridNavigationMembers-8071.test.tsx` **pins the retired substitution as intended behaviour** — `clickRow({ view: 'summary_view' })` asserting `onNavigate` was called with `('7', 'summary_view')`, under a docblock bullet teaching it as the contract. `packages/react/.../useNavigationOverlay.modeDefault.test.tsx` pins the same thing. Both go red against the fix. ⛔ Neither is skipped, disabled or quarantined: both rows are INVERTED in place, each keeping its authored `view` fixture, because that fixture is the one input the old and new implementations disagree about.

**Question 2, "what is the correct behaviour once the key is gone".** Not a product choice, so 回翻条款 does not fire: the spec names the replacement route and it is a different machinery (page assignment), while this hook's remaining job — `mode` and `size` — is untouched. Both call sites now pass the literal `'view'`, which is what every config WITHOUT the key already dispatched. The one judgement call is flagged for the seat below.

## What changed

- `packages/react/src/hooks/useNavigationOverlay.ts` — the read is gone; both `view ?? 'view'` sites pass `'view'`; `NavigationOverlayState` loses its `view` member; the module docblock gains the retirement, the prescription and the census; one authoring example that spelled the retired key is rewritten.
- `packages/react/.../useNavigationOverlay.modeDefault.test.tsx` — one row inverted, one row added (the state shape, asserted on the KEY rather than on the value, because `toBeUndefined()` passes just as happily against the member this PR removed).
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/gridNavigationMembers-8071.test.tsx` — one row inverted, three comment blocks corrected.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` — a comment my change falsifies. It claimed a custom name arrived here "forwarded from `navigation.view`" and was "resolved by RecordDetailView from its own config". No layer ever resolved a view by that name. ⭐ This branch already treated the name and the mode token identically, which is exactly what made the substitution inaudible on the Console: behaviour there is unchanged, and that is the finding rather than a caveat.
- `.changeset/9874-navigation-view-retired-consumer.md` — `minor`, per this repo's policy that its own breaking changes ship as `minor` with the semantics in the body.

## Ablation — two legs, both restored and proven

Direction predicted before running: **turn red**, exactly two rows. Both legs mutate the real source, prove the mutation by blob hash, run, restore, and prove the restore by hash equality AND an empty `git diff HEAD`, with `trap ... EXIT INT TERM` on absolute paths.

⭐ The ablation mutates `packages/react/src`, and the plugin-grid leg imports `@object-ui/react` by package specifier — the root `vitest.config.mts` aliases that specifier to `./packages/react/src`, so no `dist` rebuild is interposed. The plugin-grid row going red is itself the proof that the alias is live.

**Leg 1 — the substitution.** Value chosen because the two implementations DISAGREE about it: an authored `view: 'summary_view'` with the mode defaulting.

```
HEAD blob    : 68d8c2061376f3361b37fdf846fae2615014df67
post-mutation: 555d87b4a2bcbeb18ba87c073251ecd3473b8c04   (differs — mutation landed)
MUTATED  exit 1 — Tests 2 failed | 26 passed (28)
  FAIL gridNavigationMembers-8071 ... expected "vi.fn()" to be called with arguments: [ '7', 'view' ]
  FAIL useNavigationOverlay.modeDefault ... expected "vi.fn()" to be called with arguments: [ 'r1', 'view' ]
restored     : 68d8c2061376f3361b37fdf846fae2615014df67   (equals HEAD blob)
git diff HEAD: EMPTY
RESTORED exit 0 — Tests 28 passed (28)
```

**Leg 2 — the published state shape.** Re-adding the `view` member to the returned object:

```
HEAD blob    : 68d8c2061376f3361b37fdf846fae2615014df67
post-mutation: 87fc43aa850d493909445b7dfa853589e3fb91fb   (differs — mutation landed)
MUTATED  exit 1 — Tests 1 failed | 16 passed (17)
  FAIL ... expected [ 'isOpen', 'selectedRecord', ...(8) ] to not include 'view'
restored     : 68d8c2061376f3361b37fdf846fae2615014df67   ·   git diff HEAD: EMPTY
RESTORED exit 0 — Tests 17 passed (17)
```

⚠️ One self-correction, since a published reading has to be reproducible: leg 1's observational `grep -c "view ?? 'view'"` printed **3** where its own label said "expect 2". The third hit is prose in the docblock I added, which quotes the old spelling. The authoritative instrument is the anchored replacement inside the mutation script, which asserts exactly 2 code sites and aborts otherwise; the grep line was a loose observation and its label was wrong, not the mutation.

## Verification

All test and build runs serialized behind the seat lock (`OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=3`); each reports its own `VERDICT command-exit`. Read at final HEAD `3f2ed65c5`.

| run | result |
|---|---|
| baseline, before any edit | `Test Files 2 passed`, `Tests 27 passed` — the two files were green, so their red is caused by the fix |
| `vitest run packages/react/` plus the plugin-grid pin, the plugin-list navigation-forward test and the `packages/types` parity test | **`Test Files 91 passed (91)`, `Tests 1114 passed (1114)`** |
| `type-check` for `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` | exit 0, **0 `error TS`** — both legs ran (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), so the test sources are inside the judged set rather than excluded |
| `check:control-bytes` · `check:changeset-claims` · `check:pending-changeset-literals` · `check:new-line-citations` · `check:spec-symbols` · `check:comment-mask-corpus` · `check:handler-key-reads` | all exit 0 |
| `check:changeset-presence` · `check:changeset-no-major` | exit 0 |
| `check:governed-queue-guard --test` on the five changed paths | `NOT GOVERNED — 5 path(s) checked against 5 governed surface(s); none matched` |

⭐ The `packages/types` parity test is objectui#9667's territory and was run deliberately: it stays green, so the two halves are not entangled and this PR does not pre-empt that one.

**`check:readme-exports` — NOT MEASURED, prerequisite not met.** It needs every package's `dist` on disk and I built only the dependency closure of the three packages I touched. All **87** of its complaint lines read "is not on disk -- run `pnpm build` first", and **0** of them name any file in this diff. A whole-repo build is CI's run, not a local one.

**Lint — a narrowing, measured rather than asserted.** `eslint --no-inline-config` over the four changed source files: **exit 0, 0 errors**; the 174 warnings are pre-existing `no-explicit-any` / `react-refresh` noise in `ObjectView.tsx` and the grid test, none on a line this diff wrote. The three readings that make the narrowing a measurement:
1. **Population** read from eslint's own config via `isPathIgnored`, not guessed: **5129** lintable tracked files.
2. **Files linted this run**, counted from `--format json`: **4**.
3. **Invariance**: `eslint.config.js` has **zero** hits for `projectService`, `project:`, `parserOptions` or `tsconfigRootDir`, against a lit control in the same file on `rules` / `languageOptions` / `ignores`. Type-aware linting is off, so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

**⭐ One judgement worth a maintainer's eye, called out rather than buried.** Removing `view` from `NavigationOverlayState` is a breaking change to a published type. I read it as the mechanical consequence of the retirement rather than a product choice — the member could only ever carry the retired key, so keeping it would publish a field that is permanently `undefined`, which is the "declared, consumed, and wrong" state the retirement exists to end — and the in-repo census for it is a measured zero. But the alternative (keep it as a deprecated tombstone that is always `undefined`) is a real option, and it is the seat's to take. Reverting just that half is a two-line change and does not disturb anything else here.

Out of scope, noted, not filed:

- **objectstack#19030** — the producer-side union at `objectstack:packages/spec/src/ui/react-blocks.ts:321` declares the navigation-mode union as view-or-edit while this hook passes `new_window` at two sites. Untouched here and genuinely independent: after this PR the union still lacks `new_window`. Handed on rather than filed — the triage seat already recorded it against this same file. Successor: that card.

Worth its own card, handed to the seat with dedupe words rather than filed from here:

- **A published doc comment still teaches the retired key.** `packages/types/src/objectql.ts:2546` tells authors that `navigation: { view: 'summary_view' }` is legal authored metadata. On the bump this steers an author — very often an AI — to write a key the runtime rejects with the tombstone. Dedupe words: `objectql.ts navigation.view doc comment` · `retired key authored example` · `spec 17.5.0 tombstone types` · `ViewNavigationConfig legal metadata`.
- **objectui#9667's stated scope is narrower than the census.** That card names four declaration sites in one `packages/types` parity test. My authoring-site probe finds the retired key ALSO authored at `packages/types/src/__tests__/gantt-declared-keys.test.ts:117` and `:191`, `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts:386`, and `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.ganttNavigationForward-7334.test.tsx:183` and `:185` — five more, in three files that card does not name, each typing `never` on the bump. ⛔ Deliberately not touched: that repo area is the sibling half's, and widening into it is what this dispatch told me to stop and report instead of doing. Dedupe words: `navigation.view authoring sites census` · `retired key never type bump` · `gantt-declared-keys navigation view` · `9667 scope narrower than census`.

Two fixtures in THIS diff also author the retired key and are kept on purpose — they are the disagreement inputs the inverted pins rest on, and they will need the same treatment as the five above when the bump lands.

## What in the dispatch was wrong

- The base `02bc27b08` was stale; `origin/main` was `f5e2fcb4a` when I fetched.
- The declared-range summary was incomplete (it omitted `^17.1.0` and `^17.4.0`).
- The dispatch asked me to copy a `Clause-②:` line from the claim comment into this body. The claim comment on objectui#9874 carries no such line, and no gate in this repository reads one from a PR body — `check-changeset-presence.mjs` reads no PR body at all, and the marker the changeset workflow hunts for is the first line of a COMMENT. Nothing was copied because there was nothing to copy.

Everything else in the dispatch re-measured as stated — including the 4-call-site control, which is a real lit control and did its job.
